description: This PHP source file defines the class SubmitClaimRequestController, a controller responsible for handling the submission of claim requests in the OrangeHRM system. It manages pre-rendering setup for the claim submission component and checks user permissions before allowing access.

classes.name: SubmitClaimRequestController
classes.description: Controller class for handling claim request submissions; manages pre-render configuration and access control.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with claim ID and config properties before rendering.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access or modify the claim request identified by ID.
